subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental core Claws status/remove and persisted ownership contract as part of the current RFC stack?
rationale: Correctness review cannot decide whether destructive grouped lifecycle commands, durable provenance, and automatic final-reference package uninstallation should become supported core product behavior.

options.title: Sponsor the stacked lifecycle
options.body: Accept the RFC direction, review prerequisite persistence and ownership slices together, require current-head real behavior proof, then merge the stack in dependency order.

options.title: Land read-only status first
options.body: Keep lifecycle visibility but defer destructive file and package removal until the ownership and recovery contract has more operational evidence.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Keep the draft series unmerged while maintainers choose a different package and lifecycle boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the stacked lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC direction, review prerequisite persistence and ownership slices together, require current-head real behavior proof, then merge the stack in dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and supplied the ownership requirement that shaped the current removal contract.
